t: When you are frightened about money
a: ۞ وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ كُلٌّ فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
p: Wa mā min dābbatin fi-l-arḍi illā ʿala-llāhi rizquhā…
m: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allāh is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
